query:
.mode json
.timeout 3000
SELECT json_object(
 'captured_utc',datetime('now'),
 'runs',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'number',`index`,'workflow',workflow_id,'event',event,'sha',commit_sha,'ref',ref,'status',status,'created',created,'started',started,'stopped',stopped)) FROM action_run WHERE repo_id=1 AND created>=unixepoch('2026-10-07 19:29:34') AND workflow_id IN ('ci.yml','coverage.yml','main-fast-lane.yml','effort-ci.yml','validation-nightly.yml'))),
 'jobs',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',j.id,'run_id',j.run_id,'task',j.task_id,'key',j.job_id,'name',j.name,'status',j.status,'created',j.created,'started',j.started,'stopped',j.stopped)) FROM action_run_job j WHERE j.repo_id=1 AND j.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM action_run WHERE repo_id=1 AND created>=unixepoch('2026-10-07 19:29:34') AND workflow_id='ci.yml'))),
 'merges',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('pr',`index`,'sha',merged_commit_id,'head_branch',head_branch,'merged',merged_unix)) FROM pull_request WHERE base_repo_id=1 AND has_merged=1 AND base_branch='main' AND merged_unix>unixepoch('2026-10-07 19:29:34')))
);
projection_note: Ref/head-branch strings discarded; no run/job/merge rows removed. Columns include everything used by the delivered summaries.
